description:
Perform a diagnostic analysis on the 'ExamAnxiety.csv' dataset (already loaded). Fit a Linear Regression model predicting 'Exam' scores based on 'Anxiety' and 'Revise' (study time). Enable the option to save 'Cook's Distance' values to the dataset. Inspect the data to find the student (row) with the highest Cook's Distance. 

Create a report file at '~/Documents/Jamovi/influential_student_report.txt' with the following format:
model_r_squared: <value>
max_cooks_distance: <value>
student_code: <Student ID/Code>

Finally, save the Jamovi project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Influential_Analysis.omv'.
